findings.finding: Board-pack style 'X EUR M' and '23-24%' were not recognised by the grounding check; all money is written as €XM and ranges spelled out so every number is traced to a cited fact.
findings.action: Rewrote number formats; check passes with no UNSUPPORTED_NUMBER

findings.finding: The 2024 first-year churn rate (12%) comes from CS notes, not the CRM cohort table; the 14 PP rise and the €2.5M excess churn depend on it being on the same ARR basis.
findings.action: Caveat on I3/I5, lever L1 marked upper bound with validation; assumption listed in project.json

findings.finding: Board needs a decision today, not a study: the storyline must test the CRO plan, cost options, and end with approvable asks.
findings.action: Added current_plan test (does_not_hold), three costed options, approve/reject asks, gates and KPIs

findings.finding: No growth target is given; a gap without a target is meaningless.
findings.action: Working target inferred (recover the €5.6M net new ARR fall) and flagged for confirmation at the storyline checkpoint

findings.finding: Same basis check: the excess first-year churn risk was first charged only to the CRO plan. It touches every option: O2 and O3 carry it too if the onboarding fix fails, and O1/O3 add more new customers into onboarding.
findings.action: All options carry the same four components (AE opex, onboarding opex, excess churn, ramp shortfall); O2 and O3 both show 0 excess churn on the same conditional basis with the residual risk noted on both; O1 exposure flagged as a lower bound; O3 onboarding capacity risk noted

findings.finding: Competitive pressure is real at the margin: price is cited in 34% of lost deals and pipeline grew faster than new ARR. If the competitor is shrinking deal sizes, sales capacity may matter more than shown.
findings.action: Kept as caveat and contradicting fact on I2; AE envelope pre-approved rather than rejected outright, released at the gate

findings.finding: Gating the AE hire delays sales capacity: if retention recovers fast, O2 gives up part of the 2026 AE contribution versus O3.
findings.action: Trade-off stated in O2 note and gap how_closed; gap admitted as mostly 2027

findings.finding: Causality onboarding cut -> churn rests on timing and exit interviews (H2 confidence 0.8), not a controlled test.
findings.action: Caveat on I4; KPI and gate measure whether churn responds before AE money is released

findings.finding: Two slides on K1 and two on K2: each pair carries a distinct message (where vs why-not-sales; where churn sits vs why and what it cost). Marketing traffic and engineering headcount facts are irrelevant to the decision and omitted.
ARR bridge and lever sizing are changes: waterfalls. Funnel is a trend: line with callouts. Options on four components: table, not chart.
